'''Kor Hunamma''' was a [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="TEA Kor Hunamma" /> located within the [[Kor Hunamma system/Legends|Kor Hunamma system]], a part of the ''[[Bootana Hutta/Legends|Bootana Hutta]]'' region of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. It was part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] section of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It was connected by [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] to the [[Kor Usilic system/Legends|Kor Usilic]] and [[Kor Utoradii system/Legends|Kor Utoradii systems]].<ref name="TEA" />

Kor Hunamma was the [[Throneworld/Legends|throneworld]] of the [[Hunamma]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]].<ref name="TEA Kor Hunamma" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kor Hunamma was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the world in grid square S-11.<ref name="TEA" />
